events.name: Buffalo Sabres at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Jason Tucker scored twice and Alex Lyon stopped 26 shots and tied a Buffalo record with his ninth straight victory as the Sabres beat the New York Islanders 5-0 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Lyon makes 26 saves, ties Buffalo record with 9th straight win as Sabres blank Islanders 5-0

headlines.description: — Kailer Yamamoto had a goal and an assist and the Utah Mammoth extended their winning streak to five games with a 5-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth extend win streak to 5 with 5-2 victory over Predators

headlines.description: — Morgan Geekie scored his 100th career goal with 5:53 remaining to break a tie and give the Boston Bruins a 4-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geekie scores 100th career goal, Bruins beat Canadiens 4-3

headlines.description: — William Carrier, Seth Jarvis and Taylor Hall scored in the first period and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Ottawa Senators 4-1 on Saturday night to take the Eastern Conference lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes beat Senators 4-1 to take the Eastern Conference lead

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Mason Marchment recorded his third career hat trick, and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat Tampa Bay 8-5 on Saturday night, ending the Lightning's streak of 15 straight games without a regulation loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchment’s hat trick lifts Blue Jackets past Lightning 8-5

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — J.T. Compher scored twice as the Detroit Red Wings defeated the Winnipeg Jets 5-1 in front of a sold-out crowd of 15,225 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Wings score 4 times in third period to beat Jets 5-1

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Trevor Moore scored the deciding goal in the shootout and had a goal in regulation in his first game since being activated off injured reserve to help the Los Angeles Kings beat the St. Louis Blues 5-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moore scores deciding goal in shootout as Kings beat Blues 5-4

headlines.description: — Brad Marchand scored twice, with his second coming 3 minutes into overtime, and the Florida Panthers won their third-straight road game with a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brad Marchand scores 2, including decisive OT goal, in Panthers 4-3 win over Wild

headlines.description: Connor McDavid scored 46 seconds into overtime, Evan Bouchard had his first NHL hat trick and three assists, and the Edmonton Oilers held on for a 6-5 win over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid scores in OT, Bouchard nets hat trick as Oilers edge Capitals 6-5
